CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JANUARY 28, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Councilmember Raskin at 5:30
p.m., on Wednesday, January 28, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA., and
teleconference location in Ketchum, 1D 83340.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis (via telephone at 5:34 p.m.)
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Absent:  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Barry Snell

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Acting Chair, the City Council convened at 5:30 p.m., with
  all members present except Councilmember Snell, Mayor Pro Tern Zwick,
  and Mayor Torosis. Councilmember Hall led the assemblage in the Pledge
  of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Negrete.
(LAND
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

VOTE FOR ACTING  Due to the Mayor not joining the meeting until Closed session,
CHAIR  Councilmember Raskin volunteered to sit as the Acting Chair for the
  meeting. There being no objections, Councilmember Raskin was
  unanimously appointed by voice vote, with Mayor Torosis, Mayor Pro Tem
  Zwick, and Councilmember Snell absent.

PUBLIC INPUT FOR  There were no members of the public present to comment on Closed Session
CLOSED SESSION ONLY: items.

  January 28, 2026
 CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:34 p.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 6:53 p.m., with Mayor Pro Tern Zwick and
Mayor Torosis arrived via
  Councilmember Snell absent, to report the following:
teleconference at 5:34 p.m.
  Acting Chair Raskin, advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Acting Chair, the City Council meeting adjourned at 6:53
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  ��
  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ellis Raskin
  Interim City Clerk  Acting Chair

  January 28, 2026
